quote: The lookup deliberately includes closed PRs and this condition accepts any marker-bearing candidate as published. After a crash or lost response, a previously created draft may be closed before restart; the UI then offers Open PR for a closed item instead of creating or reporting a recoverable draft.
note: The earlier “Do not report a closed marked PR as published” item questioned the same recovery lookup and was no longer open at merge. It addressed accepting a closed draft with a matching marker, while the shipped bug came from missing a closed PR that had accepted an update and still carried the original request marker.
